selection.scope_note: The user reduced the run count to the first5 original identities; no replacement/resampling of identities or scored retries

terminal_run_elapsed_span.scope: terminal runs only; includes inter-run gaps

limits: Error text is hashed/classified, never copied into this report.
Usage is exact only when every saved response provides counters; unanswered/error requests remain unknown.
Images count decision attachments, not all wire retransmissions.
Catalogs/traces verify declared host-tool isolation and observed executions; full wire tool arrays are not captured for every turn.
Effective current masks are verified against saved mapping arrays, not against simulator ground-truth instances.
Summed policy/perception times are not elapsed runtime.
Partial mode reports persisted attempts only; an active episode is not made into a scored or error attempt.

historical_v8_same_identity_reference.limits: Historical same-identity reference only. Foundation model and reasoning effort are verified against each matched source run; perception, scene memory and navigation changed together. This is not an isolated memory ablation or a full-split performance comparison. No new historical rollout or rescore was performed.

official_source.method: original hash-pinned goal/helper AST bodies; object.__new__; no constructors/imported simulator

explanatory_correction.reason: The original comparison note incorrectly asserted different reasoning configuration; every matched v8 run actually uses the same gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 model and medium effort. Numeric metrics and all task/actor/SQLite/official-AST audit results are unchanged.
